newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein easier, trade dull.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein easier, trade dull.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were easier in late trading on Monday on limited buying interest ahead of the holiday season, traders said.

They said olein was quoted at 1,440-45 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,445-50 rupiah at the opening. Offers were also heard at 1,430-35 rupiah. Crude palm oil was on offer at around 1,215 rupiah/kg in the North Sumatran city of Medan.
"The market has been very quiet today," one trader said. "Players are not taking positions ahead of the holidays. Although there has been some consumer demand, the overall market is generally quiet."
Traders said the market ignored a statement by head of the state logistics agency BULOG that the government might import more olein if local prices could not be controlled.
Beddu Amang said last Friday that the government had taken delivery of 38,000 tonnes of the 52,000 tonnes of Malaysian olein it planned to import till January.
Indonesia would import more olein from Malaysia if local prices could not be controlled, he said.
"His remarks had no impact because BULOG's imports are known to the market," one trader said. "I also don't see BULOG intervening in the market, if at all, before January."
